text.en: An ovary releases an egg. If a sperm joins it and it settles in the uterus, pregnancy begins.
text.hg: Ovary ek egg release karti hai. Agar sperm usse mil jaaye aur woh uterus mein settle ho jaaye, toh pregnancy shuru hoti hai.

label.en: It can happen the first time
label.hg: Pehli baar mein bhi pregnancy ho sakti hai

text.en: Sperm can live about five days and ovulation day shifts, so counting 'safe days' is unreliable.
text.hg: Sperm lagbhag paanch din zinda reh sakte hain aur ovulation ka din shift hota rehta hai, isliye 'safe days' ginna reliable nahi.

text.en: Condoms, pills, injections, IUDs and implants prevent pregnancy, but none is 100 percent and each must be used correctly.
text.hg: Condoms, pills, injections, IUDs aur implants pregnancy rokte hain, par koi bhi 100 percent nahi, aur har ek ko sahi tareeke se use karna zaroori hai.

label.hg: STI risk sirf condom kam karta hai

text.en: Condoms are the only method that also lowers the risk of sexually transmitted infections.
text.hg: Condom akela aisa method hai jo sexually transmitted infections (STIs) ka risk bhi kam karta hai.

text.en: Not having sex is the only completely certain way, and choosing to wait is common and valid.
text.hg: Sex na karna hi poori tarah pakka tareeka hai, aur wait karna common bhi hai aur valid bhi.

text.en: Doctors, counsellors, trusted adults and Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics are better sources than forwards and random videos.
text.hg: Doctors, counsellors, trusted adults aur Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHC) forwards aur random videos se kahin better sources hain.

title.en: Using a condom: do and avoid

points.en: Put it on before any genital contact and keep it on start to finish.
points.hg: Kisi bhi genital contact se pehle pehno, aur start se finish tak pehne raho.

points.en: Leave space at the tip and hold the base while withdrawing.
points.hg: Tip par space chhodo, aur bahar nikalte waqt base ko pakad kar rakho.

points.en: Use only water-based or silicone-based lubricant with latex.
points.hg: Latex ke saath sirf water-based ya silicone-based lubricant use karo.

points.en: Check the expiry date and keep condoms away from heat.
points.hg: Expiry date check karo, aur condoms ko heat se door rakho.

points.en: Opening the packet with your teeth
Oil, petroleum jelly or body lotion, which weaken latex
points.hg: Oil, petroleum jelly ya body lotion, jo latex ko weak karte hain

points.en: Wearing two at once, or reusing one
points.hg: Ek saath do pehenna, ya ek hi condom reuse karna

points.en: Keeping them in a wallet or a vehicle's storage box
points.hg: Unhe wallet ya gaadi ki dickey mein rakhna

text.en: Taken daily, it mainly stops ovulation. Typical use: about 7 pregnancies in 100 users a year.
text.hg: Roz li jaati hai aur mainly ovulation rokti hai. Typical use mein saal bhar mein 100 mein se lagbhag 7 ko pregnancy hoti hai.

text.en: A health worker gives it every 2 or 3 months. Typical use: about 4 pregnancies in 100 a year.
text.hg: Health worker ise har 2 ya 3 mahine mein lagate hain. Typical use mein saal bhar mein 100 mein se lagbhag 4 ko pregnancy.

text.en: A small T-shaped device in the uterus that works for years. Fewer than 1 pregnancy in 100 users a year.
text.hg: Uterus ke andar lagne wala chhota T-shaped device, jo kai saal kaam karta hai. Saal bhar mein 100 mein se 1 se bhi kam ko pregnancy.

text.en: A thin rod under the skin of the upper arm that works for years. Also fewer than 1 in 100.
text.hg: Upper arm ki skin ke neeche lagi patli rod, jo kai saal kaam karti hai. Ismein bhi 100 mein se 1 se kam.

text.en: Delays ovulation and works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, the sooner the better. It is not abortion.
text.hg: Ovulation ko delay karti hai aur unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karti hai, jitni jaldi utna better. Yeh abortion nahi hai.

text.en: None of these methods protects against STIs. Only condoms lower that risk.
text.hg: Inmein se koi bhi method STI se protect nahi karta. Woh risk sirf condom kam karta hai.

title.en: Less to remember, lower pregnancy risk
title.hg: Yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam, toh pregnancy ka risk bhi kam

points.en: Implant: under 1 pregnancy in 100 users a year, typical use
points.hg: Implant: typical use mein saal bhar mein 100 mein 1 se kam pregnancy

points.en: Hormonal or copper IUD: also under 1 in 100
points.hg: Hormonal ya copper IUD: ismein bhi 100 mein 1 se kam

points.en: Can be removed early, and fertility returns quickly
points.hg: Time se pehle bhi nikalwa sakte ho, aur fertility jaldi wapas aa jaati hai

points.en: No STI protection, so many adults add a condom
points.hg: STI protection nahi, isliye kai adults saath mein condom bhi use karte hain

points.en: Combined pill: about 7 in 100 a year, typical use
points.hg: Combined pill: typical use mein saal bhar mein 100 mein lagbhag 7

points.en: External condom: about 13, but it also lowers STI risk
points.hg: External condom: lagbhag 13, par yeh STI risk bhi kam karta hai

points.en: Withdrawal: about 20, and calendar counting is not reliable
points.hg: Withdrawal: lagbhag 20, aur calendar counting reliable nahi

title.en: When plans fail: the next steps
title.hg: Plan fail ho jaaye toh: next steps

text.en: EC pills work best early, within 5 days; a copper IUD fitted in that time is most effective.
text.hg: EC pills jitni jaldi lo utni effective, 5 din ke andar; is time mein lagwaya gaya copper IUD sabse effective hai.

label.en: Cover the rest of the cycle

text.en: EC does not protect for the rest of the cycle, so use condoms or start a regular method.
text.hg: EC baaki cycle ke liye protect nahi karti, isliye condom use karo ya koi regular method start karo.

label.en: Test if your period is late
label.hg: Period late ho toh test karo

text.en: More than a week late, or about three weeks after unprotected sex? Take a pregnancy test.
text.hg: Period ek hafte se zyada late hai, ya unprotected sex ko lagbhag teen hafte ho gaye? Pregnancy test karo.

text.en: Positive test, or needing EC again and again? See a doctor early to talk it through.
text.hg: Test positive aaya, ya baar-baar EC leni pad rahi hai? Jaldi doctor se milkar khul ke baat karo.

text.en: With a possible pregnancy, one-sided lower abdominal pain, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting needs urgent hospital care.
text.hg: Pregnancy possible ho aur lower abdomen mein ek taraf dard, bleeding, shoulder-tip pain ya behoshi ho, toh turant hospital jao.
